correctness.rationale: For every bounded centered rank-one copula density c=1+q(u)p(v), the essential extrema alpha<0<beta of q give a valid binary latent J with pi=-alpha/(beta-alpha), w=(q-alpha)/(beta-alpha), and conditional V densities 1+alpha p,1+beta p. Thus U->J->V is Markov, establishing 0<=I(U;V)<=H(J)<=log 2. Equality forces pi=1/2 and deterministic common J measurable from each coordinate; both margins are uniform and conditional independence gives exactly two equal-measure matching rectangles with density 2. Covariance through binary J bounds |rho_S|<=3/4; integration by parts for C=uv+g(u)h(v) proves tau=(2/3)rho_S. For t=1/4-r/3, A_t=[0,t] union [t+1/2,1], B=[1/2,1] have half measure, yield I=log 2, rho_S=3/4-3t=r and all r in [-3/4,3/4], including endpoints and zero. Independently recomputed exact sign first moments and rho for r=-3/4,-1/4,0,1/3,3/4; checked the analytical equality and boundary arguments. Does not extend beyond one separable bounded perturbation.
